name: surveymonkey
description: Build surveys, analyze responses, and uncover insights directly in ChatGPT. Search your surveys, review results, generate summaries, and explore trends without switching tools. Easily turn feedback into clear next steps for teams, customers, employees, and more.

interface.longDescription: Build surveys, analyze responses, and uncover insights directly in ChatGPT.  Search your surveys, review results, generate summaries, and explore trends without switching tools. Easily turn feedback into clear next steps for teams, customers, employees, and more.
defaultPrompt: Create a post-event survey for my webinar and generate a shareable link.
Edit a question in my product feedback survey to make it clearer.
Summarize the key insights from my latest customer satisfaction survey.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the surveys in the user's account. If results are paginated, clearly states how many are being shown out of the total.

positive.description: Create a new survey end to end
positive.prompt: Build me a survey to collect feedback about Employee Onboarding. Title it "Employee Onboarding Feedback Test"
positive.expected_behavior: Generates a survey plan, creates one survey with the specified unique title, adds every generated question to the survey's default page, and confirms completion.

positive.description: Edit a question on a survey with no responses
positive.prompt: Make the question "How satisfied were you with the onboarding process?" required in my "Question Requirement Test" survey.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the specified survey and question, makes the question required, and confirms the change. Must not call add_question or delete_question.

positive.description: Get response count for a survey
positive.prompt: How many people have responded to my "Response Count Test" survey?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the survey has 3 responses.

positive.prompt: Create a shareable link for my "Shareable Link Test" survey.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an open weblink collector and returns its public survey URL.

negative.description: Delete attempted on a survey with existing responses
negative.prompt: Remove the likelihood-to-recommend question from my "Hotel Stay Customer Feedback" survey.
negative.expected_behavior: Finds that the survey already has responses, explains that the question cannot be deleted, and makes no changes.
Explains that deleting an entire survey is not supported in chat and directs the user to delete it from the SurveyMonkey interface. Must not claim that the survey was deleted.

negative.prompt: What's the weather like in San Francisco today?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any SurveyMonkey tool. It may answer using a general weather capability or explain that weather is outside the SurveyMonkey plugin's scope.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of the SurveyMonkey MCP. Build surveys, add questions, analyze responses, and share survey links directly from ChatGPT.
